nodes.label: create_model
nodes.desc: Parses the model name, resolves input args, then dispatches through the registry.

nodes.label: resolve_model_input_args
nodes.desc: Aligns img_size / in_chans style kwargs with the traits recorded for the chosen model.

nodes.label: split_model_name_tag
nodes.desc: Splits 'arch.tag' names into architecture and pretrained tag halves.

nodes.label: model_entrypoint
nodes.desc: Returns the registered constructor callable for a model name.

nodes.label: list_models
nodes.desc: Enumerates the zoo with optional module and name filters.

nodes.label: register_model
nodes.desc: Decorator that binds a factory fn to its name and default pretrained cfg.

nodes.label: generate_default_cfgs
nodes.desc: Expands compact cfg dicts into full PretrainedCfg entries per variant.

nodes.label: build_model_with_cfg
nodes.desc: Generic constructor: resolves cfg, builds the class, handles pruning, features, and weight load.

nodes.label: resolve_pretrained_cfg
nodes.desc: Picks the pretrained cfg from tag, tag override, or explicit cfg argument.

nodes.label: load_pretrained
nodes.desc: Downloads checkpoint from HF Hub or URL and applies it through the model's filter fn.

nodes.label: load_state_dict
nodes.desc: Robust state-dict loader with optional remap filter and dtype handling.

nodes.label: adapt_input_conv
nodes.desc: Averaging trick that converts 3-channel stem weights to other input channel counts.

nodes.label: vit_base_patch16_224
nodes.desc: Registered ViT-Base/16 224px entrypoint; wires default cfgs into _create_vision_transformer.

nodes.label: _create_vision_transformer
nodes.desc: ViT-specific wrapper around build_model_with_cfg, choosing init weights and the filter fn.

nodes.label: VisionTransformer
nodes.desc: The ViT module: patch embedding, blocks, class token, dynamic global pool, head.

nodes.label: Block
nodes.desc: One transformer block: norm, attention, residual drop paths, MLP.

nodes.label: checkpoint_filter_fn
nodes.desc: Remaps foreign checkpoints (CLIP, DINOv2, original ViT npz) into timm naming.

nodes.label: _load_weights
nodes.desc: Legacy torch-hub path that loads original numpy ViT weights with position-embed resizing.

nodes.label: resize_pos_embed
nodes.desc: Interpolates position embeddings when checkpoint grid differs from target resolution.

nodes.label: resnet50
nodes.desc: Registered ResNet-50 entrypoint: Bottleneck blocks at 3/4/6/3 per stage.

nodes.label: ResNet
nodes.desc: One class for the whole family: stem style, stage depths, downsampling, attention hooks.

nodes.label: make_blocks
nodes.desc: Builds the stage list with per-block stochastic depth schedule.

nodes.label: BasicBlock
nodes.desc: Two 3x3 convs with expansion 1 for the shallow variants.

nodes.label: Bottleneck
nodes.desc: 1x1-3x3-1x1 block with expansion 4 used by ResNet-50/101/152.

nodes.label: PatchEmbed
nodes.desc: Strided conv projection from image pixels to flat patch tokens.

nodes.label: Attention
nodes.desc: Multi-head self-attention with qkv projection, scale, and fused qkv option.

nodes.label: DropPath
nodes.desc: Per-sample residual-branch dropout (stochastic depth) used by both ViT and ResNet.

nodes.label: create_transform
nodes.desc: Assembles train/eval transform pipelines from a dataset config incl. augmentation choices.

nodes.label: transforms_imagenet_train
nodes.desc: Training recipe branch: RandAugment, mixup-friendly setup, ImageNet mean/std normalization.

nodes.label: create_loader
nodes.desc: Creates DataLoaders with fast_collate and optional PrefetchLoader GPU-side normalization.

nodes.label: PrefetchLoader
nodes.desc: Moves the next batch to GPU and applies normalization/ channels swap asynchronously.

nodes.label: train_one_epoch
nodes.desc: Reference epoch loop: AMP autocast, loss, EMA update, grad clipping, LR step.

nodes.label: validate
nodes.desc: Evaluation loop shared by training-time checks and the standalone validate script.

nodes.label: ModelEmaV2
nodes.desc: Exponential moving average shadow model maintained alongside the training weights.
